parent_authority.rule: This record refines the internal architecture of the existing BOOK peer only. It creates no peer, transfers no cross-peer semantic authority, changes no System Master topology and does not resurrect PROSE. Parent authority wins on conflict.

decision.architecture_rule: Historical packet, module and specialist authority IDs remain immutable lineage and may survive as aliases or bounded subauthorities. Canonical product components are stable semantic boundaries, not packet numbers.

components.name: Writing and Authoring
owns: author intent and audience semantics
book architecture and unit design semantics
drafting and continuation semantics
developmental, macro, line, copy and text-proof editing semantics
voice, style and accepted-expression decision semantics
candidate-to-accepted-text semantic admission requirements
absorbed_or_historical_facets: PROSE-CRAFT capability evidence is historical/completed input consumed by Book-owned integration; PROSE is not an active component or authority lane

components.name: Manuscript, Work and Edition Identity
owns: Work, Expression, Manifestation and Item identity
durable manuscript structure and revision identity
edition and package identity
Book-specific version lineage and reversible-history semantics
semantic import acceptance and loss/conflict accounting

components.name: Story Bible, Canon and Continuity
owns: author-ratified canon and world-state semantics
entity, alias, state, relation, event, temporal, spatial, object and knowledge models
promises, reveals, world rules and continuity findings
branch, retcon and merge canon lineage
Book semantic context selection and canon delta emission
absorbed_or_overlay_facets: BOOK-KNOWLEDGE-CANON-001 lifecycle sufficiency/promotion policy is an overlay across Story Bible and Book Lifecycle, not an eleventh component

components.name: Book Research and Evidence
owns: Book-specific research questions and evidence needs
claim-to-evidence workflow semantics
Book-side source admission, applicability and verification state
citation/evidence use decisions inside Book workflows

components.name: Book Workflow and Lifecycle
owns: Book phases, gates, exact-next and reopen semantics
Book-specific admission and invalidation rules
workflow state projections and progress truth
coordination of candidate generation, review, ratification and canonical admission
Book-side retry/idempotency/cancel/resume policy atop shared runtime
components.canonical_mutation_rule: Canonical manuscript mutation is admitted only through the SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK canonical admission gate. Delegated services may propose, analyze, render, store or transport but may not acquire canonical Book write authority.

components.name: Existing-Book Recovery and Reconstruction
owns: existing-book semantic reconstruction
recovery completeness and uncertainty state
conflict preservation and author reconciliation workflow
candidate reconstruction of manuscript and Story Bible state with source lineage
must_not_own: automatic canonization of recovered or inferred material

components.name: Book Collaboration, Roles and Visibility
owns: Book collaborator roles and participation semantics
Book ACL/visibility policy semantics
authorization outcome consumption for author/canon actions

components.name: Rights and Permissions
owns: Book rights/permission/license record semantics
rights readiness and unresolved-rights findings
binding Book publication/reuse decisions to real rights evidence
components.authority_fence: This component records and applies rights evidence but may not synthesize legal clearance, permission, contract, copyright ownership or external legal standing that has not actually been established.

components.name: Publication, Release and External Handoff
owns: Book-specific proof/production-integrity semantics
publication product and metadata readiness semantics
release plan and release-state semantics
post-release verification and distribution-integrity semantics
publisher/agent submission, package, handoff and external-response state
baseline_scope: DOCX/PDF manuscript output readiness is core Book product scope
delegation_rules: CONNECTED_ACTIONS owns consequential external browser/communication/plugin side effects
Book owns the semantic decision, readiness, state and reconciliation of those operations

components.name: Preservation, Restore and Edition Continuity
owns: Book preservation/archival-continuity requirements
Book backup/restore semantic completeness and recovery-point expectations
later-edition re-entry and revision-lineage semantics
semantic delta impact classification and selective Book requalification decisions
Book-level offline/endurance continuity requirements
delegation_rules: CORE/DATA/artifact services own generic durable storage, transaction, backup and recovery mechanics
Book owns what constitutes a semantically complete and usable Book restore and which Book subjects become stale after accepted changes

BOOK-ENG-008.core: Book publication readiness plus DOCX/PDF outcome remains core through BOOK-PUBLICATION-001 with DOCUMENTS mechanics delegated
BOOK-ENG-008.triggered: EPUB/accessibility/channel/provider certification and external release remain trigger-gated

BOOK-ENG-009.rule: Preservation/restore is ahead of specialist publication features in implementation dependency order; generic storage/recovery remains delegated to CORE/DATA/artifact infrastructure.

BOOK-ENG-010.replacement_semantics: compact deterministic regression, representative end-to-end Book journeys, role/model requalification on material change, and independent/human quality gates where applicable

shared_peer_interfaces.CORE: shared durable jobs, transaction/data mechanics, artifact/evidence custody, assurance, continuity, resource governance and A-01 infrastructure
shared_peer_interfaces.RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE: general research retrieval, knowledge and provenance semantics
shared_peer_interfaces.CONNECTED_ACTIONS: external browser/communication/plugin/publication side-effect execution under explicit authority
shared_peer_interfaces.MEDIA: headless image/audio/video/audiobook/media production when Book workflows request it
shared_peer_interfaces.SPREADSHEET_DATA: spreadsheet/data processing only when a Book workflow explicitly needs it
shared_peer_interfaces.PROGRAMMING: code/automation/website capabilities only through explicit cross-peer interfaces
shared_peer_interfaces.LEARNING: no Book semantic ownership transfer; optional learning interfaces only when explicitly invoked

user_experience_projection.user_facing_stage_model_rule: The 227-step lifecycle remains internal planning/qualification intelligence. UI should project a small stage model, automatically resolving steps that are inapplicable, already satisfied or automatic.

non_components: PROSE-CRAFT as an active owner lane
BOOK-KNOWLEDGE-CANON-001 as a separate product component
UAF-BOOK-INTELLIGENCE-014 through 021 as eight separate product components
BOOK-ENG-001 through BOOK-ENG-010 as product components

evidence_and_lineage.lineage_rule: Historical artifacts, packet IDs, evidence labels and PASS scope remain unchanged. This record is a current component projection, not a retroactive rewrite.

promotion_policy.reason: Do not create avoidable CURRENT-AUTHORITY exact-subject churn merely to record an internal Book component decision. Promote the next Book control/state pointer in a deliberate batched Book authority transaction after downstream control artifacts are prepared.
promotion_policy.next_book_control_effect: BOOK-HIGHER-LEDGER-008-010-CURRENT-DISPOSITION-001 is architecturally resolved by this record; the next Book control revision should select the first dependency-valid implementation/qualification slice without reopening BOOK-ENG-001..007, Book Intelligence 001..021 or Story Bible SB-01..36 absent exact contradictory evidence.
